profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company (Nasdaq: ZS, CIK 0001713683) that describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its core platform, the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, is designed to connect users, devices, and applications without relying on traditional network perimeter models. The company describes its security cloud as the largest of its kind and positions itself as a recognized leader in zero trust architecture.

Zscaler's primary AI product, tracked on this site as Zscaler AI, is built into its Security Service Edge platform and covers cloud security, data loss prevention, and AI traffic inspection. The company also describes a framework for governing agent-to-agent interactions and tracing data lineage, which it presents as important for maintaining compliance and trust in AI-driven environments. Zscaler supports its platform through an ecosystem of partners and integrations intended to accelerate deployment and operations for enterprise customers.

The held facts show no litigation or MCP server entries on record. Zscaler is confirmed as a for-profit public company, verified on this site as of August 23, 2026.
